server.instructions: DATA Pro knowledge base (Postgres/pgvector). Use tools for search/ingest, resources for documents and metadata, prompts for grounded answers. Answer only from retrieved context.

search_documents.description: Semantic search over ingested document chunks. Returns ranked chunks with citations.

list_sources.description: List ingested source files with chunk counts and last-ingested timestamps.

get_chunk.description: Fetch one chunk by source file name and chunk id (e.g. travel_policy.md / chunk_00).

knowledge_base_stats.description: Return total chunk count and number of ingested source files.

list_available_documents.description: List files on disk that can be ingested (may not yet be in the database).

ingest_documents.description: Ingest documents from sample_docs (or docs_path) into the knowledge base.

ragpro://knowledge-base/stats.name: knowledge_base_stats
ragpro://knowledge-base/stats.description: Knowledge base totals, source count, and embedding model.

ragpro://knowledge-base/sources.name: ingested_sources
ragpro://knowledge-base/sources.description: All ingested source files with chunk counts.

ragpro://chunks/{source_file}/{chunk_id}.name: chunk
ragpro://chunks/{source_file}/{chunk_id}.description: A single ingested chunk from the knowledge base.

ragpro://documents/{source_file}.name: ingested_document
ragpro://documents/{source_file}.description: All ingested chunks for a source file, ordered by chunk id.

ragpro://sample-docs/{file_name}.name: sample_document
ragpro://sample-docs/{file_name}.description: Raw document text from sample_docs on disk.

citation_rules.description: Grounding and citation rules for answering from the knowledge base.
citation_rules.template:
You are an internal knowledge assistant.
Answer only from provided document context retrieved via ragpro tools or resources.
If the answer is not supported by the context, say:
"I do not know based on the provided documents."
Always cite sources in the format [source_file - chunk_id].
Be concise, helpful, and conversational.

grounded_answer.description: Retrieve top chunks for a question and return a grounded answer prompt.

summarize_document.description: Build a prompt to summarize one ingested source file from the knowledge base.
